# Multimodal model method index

[简体中文](../../multimodal-models/catalog.md) · English

This index includes implemented papers and high-cost research material. Listing does not imply implementation. See paper write-ups and receipts for public-data runs and GPU validation status.
The mapping from backbone connectors to paper-derived genomes is listed here as well.

## Paper operators available to Evolve

| Genome | Source | Main change |
|---|---|---|
| `micro_vlm_linear` | Basic CLIP / LLaVA projection | Linear connector retaining all patch tokens |
| `micro_vlm_mlp` | LLaVA | Two-layer nonlinear projector |
| `micro_vlm_qformer` | BLIP-2 | Learned query cross-attention, 16 → 4 tokens |
| `micro_vlm_pixelshuffle` | SmolVLM | 2×2 space-to-depth, 16 → 4 tokens |
| `objective:siglip2` | SigLIP 2 | Sigmoid image–text objective and masked-view consistency |
